lines.en: Snout low, I stride over the rubble
Four legs press out heavy footsteps

lines.zh: 鳄鱼的皮，霸王龙的架子
lines.en: A crocodile's hide on a tyrant's frame
My tail drags the ground with a rasp
A Triassic hunter patrols its ground
I close in on the low brush step by step
I walk the waste over old bones
My claws churn the soft mud
I push my long snout into the grass
My heavy body scrapes through the shrubs
Every step makes the ground tremble
I raise my head and sniff the air ahead

lines.zh: 皮甲擦着石头发出闷响
lines.en: My hide grates against the stone
The old master of North America walks
I crouch low and gather my strength
Long snout half open, I breathe heavily
I stare into the distance without moving
My tail sweeps slowly over the ground
This body has waited since the Triassic
I half close my eyes, but I am not asleep
The hot wind dries my hide

lines.zh: 我站着，像块会呼吸的岩
lines.en: I stand like a breathing rock
My jaws grind and click
I am waiting for someone to move first
My toes dig slightly into the soil

lines.zh: 我安静得让鸟都不敢落
lines.en: I am so still no bird dares land
My spine rises and falls, again and again
I squint across this territory

lines.zh: 你站得太直了，我不喜欢
lines.en: You stand too upright, I dislike it

lines.zh: 两条腿的猎物，我记住了
lines.en: A two-legged prey, I will remember
Your bones look brittle
I tilt my head and measure your height

lines.zh: 你也想统治这片荒地吗
lines.en: Do you mean to rule this waste too
I smell meat at your feet
Do not think I will not strike first

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就少想一步
lines.en: Step back and I think about you less

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一条尾巴的长度
lines.en: One tail length stands between us
I watch your hands, not your face

lines.zh: 我不吃两条腿的东西，除非它先动手
lines.en: I do not eat two-legged things unless they start it

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就当你是挑战者
lines.en: Come closer and I will take you for a challenger
A plate of my hide has cracked
I growl, keeping it very low
This thing actually wounded me
I turn to look at the wound
A dull ache runs through my bones
I shake my head, blood spatters the sand

lines.zh: 四十年生命也经不住这样
lines.en: Forty health cannot take much of this
My long snout is bruised and bleeding
I fall back half a step, then steady myself
The wound burns under my scales
The smell of meat, I caught it
Is that meat in the bag

lines.zh: 三叠纪的胃口醒过来了
lines.en: My Triassic appetite has woken
Put the meat down and back away

lines.zh: 我十四点伤害不是白长的
lines.en: My fourteen damage was not earned for nothing
I could swallow this in one bite

lines.zh: 我的长嘴已经朝你偏过去
lines.en: My long snout has already turned your way
Hold the meat and we can still talk
I pace slowly toward the scent
Stop waving it, I cannot see the meat

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上我的肋骨
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my ribs
My long snout knocked into you
Neither of us gave way on that one
I was shoved a step sideways

lines.zh: 你撞在我最硬的背甲上
lines.en: You hit my hardest back plate
My scaly hide scraped your boot
We stand shoulder to shoulder, neither backing off

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩到了你的脚
lines.en: My claw came down on your foot

lines.zh: 撞一下，你就知道分量了
lines.en: One bump and you know my weight
I clear the path with my tail

lines.zh: 两只长嘴慢慢并到一处
lines.en: Two long snouts slowly come together

lines.zh: 我们在荒地上并排站定
lines.en: We take our places side by side on the waste

lines.zh: 我的尾巴绕住了你的尾巴
lines.en: My tail curls around yours
One territory, two masters

lines.zh: 你用吻部碰了碰我的颈
lines.en: You nudge my neck with your snout
We growl and trade scents

lines.zh: 骨头掉在脚边，我们不看
lines.en: Bones fall at our feet, we pay no mind
The Triassic rules are simple

lines.zh: 我们一起把头抬向太阳
lines.en: We lift our heads toward the sun together

lines.zh: 这一对能守住整片荒地
lines.en: This pair can hold the whole waste
I pick up a pelvis bone
This bone joins my collection
I lower my head and carry off the meat
Whatever falls to the ground is mine
I catch it in my teeth and toss it up
This stretch of spine has little meat
I drag it toward the shade
I pin it with a claw, then lift it
Fragments too, all mine
I work it down bit by bit
Something living, I see it
It moved, so it is prey
I lower myself and load my hind legs
That life is mine to take
My four legs begin to accelerate
The target is within ten paces
I have fixed on its neck
No outsiders on this ground
I open my long snout and roar first
It turned, even better

lines.zh: 长嘴后头的眼睛盯死了你
lines.en: The eyes behind my long snout have you pinned

lines.zh: 风把它的味道送到我鼻前
lines.en: The wind carries its scent to my snout
That height is within my reach
I decide to eat this tonight
I follow its footprints
The prey is breathing behind the brush
I circle around to its downwind side
My snout aims at its flank
It runs, so I chase
I keep three blocks of patience

lines.zh: 沙地上全是我们的影子
lines.en: Our shadows fill the sand
I tighten the distance step by step
It is almost out of strength
These jaws are already lifting
I hear the dry branch it snapped
One more turn and it is finished
My breathing slows down further

lines.zh: 猎物每一步都在我算中
lines.en: Every step of the prey is in my count

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经刨开了土
lines.en: My claws have already torn the soil
Fourteen damage behind these jaws
I bite into its shoulder
My snout shuts and bone cracks
My foreclaw knocks it down first
This toss throws it clear
My teeth tear through its hide
My tail cracks across its ribs
One bite did not finish it, so I bite again
It thrashes inside my jaws
I press it down into the mud
I drop my weight and ram it
My foreclaw sweeps its legs
My teeth sink into its neck
This bite goes deep

lines.zh: 我从三叠纪的土层里出来
lines.en: I climb out of the Triassic layer

lines.zh: 恐龙称王之前，这里是我的
lines.en: Before the dinosaurs ruled, this was mine
My long snout pushes the brush apart first
Forty health and fourteen points of teeth

lines.zh: 北美曾经的统治者到了
lines.en: The former ruler of North America has come

lines.zh: 我的背甲比这片石头更老
lines.en: My hide is older than this stone

lines.zh: 尘土里站起一头活鳄龙
lines.en: A living crocodile-tyrant rises from the dust

lines.zh: 我落地时踩碎了两根骨
lines.en: I crushed two bones when I landed

lines.zh: 你们的世界多了一位霸主
lines.en: Your world has gained a master
I shake the mud from my hide

lines.zh: 这片荒地现在由我巡视
lines.en: This waste is mine to patrol now

lines.zh: 我的脚印比你的手掌还大
lines.en: My footprint is bigger than your palm
A long shadow joins the waste
I rise out of the bone pile

lines.zh: 鳞片上的尘土还没落定
lines.en: The dust has not settled on my scales
A low growl rolls out of my throat

lines.zh: 陌生的气味，我用长嘴嗅了一圈
lines.en: A strange smell; I sweep my long snout across it
I stretch my neck and look around
Flames crawl up my hide
I hit the ground hard and my legs buckle
Water pours into my long snout, so stifling
The blast peeled back my scales

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的肩甲里
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my shoulder plate

lines.zh: 那股咒力钻进我的骨头
lines.en: That magic crawled into my bones

lines.zh: 没肉可吃，我的力气在掉
lines.en: No meat, and my strength is draining

lines.zh: 雷砸在我背脊上，我抖了
lines.en: Lightning struck my spine and I shuddered
The ground vanished and the waste is gone
